name: 93 - DB - Add Observability Audit and Maintenance

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_audit_events (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    actor_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system',
    actor_name TEXT,

    event_category TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_action TEXT NOT NULL,

    entity_type TEXT,
    entity_id BIGINT,

    workflow_name TEXT,
    workflow_id TEXT,
    execution_id TEXT,

    severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info'
        CHECK (
            severity IN (
                'info',
                'warning',
                'error',
                'critical'
            )
        ),

    success BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    source_channel TEXT,
    request_reference TEXT,

    event_data JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_error_events (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    error_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    workflow_name TEXT,
    workflow_id TEXT,
    execution_id TEXT,
    node_name TEXT,

    error_type TEXT,
    error_message TEXT NOT NULL,
    stack_trace TEXT,

    severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'error'
        CHECK (
            severity IN (
                'warning',
                'error',
                'critical'
            )
        ),

    retryable BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'open',
                'acknowledged',
                'resolved',
                'ignored'
            )
        ),

    occurrence_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
        CHECK (
            occurrence_count >= 1
        ),

    input_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    error_payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    first_occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    last_occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    acknowledged_by TEXT,
    acknowledged_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    resolved_by TEXT,
    resolution_note TEXT,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_health_snapshots (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    overall_status TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            overall_status IN (
                'healthy',
                'degraded',
                'unhealthy'
            )
        ),

    checks JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    metrics JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintenance_runs (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    run_type TEXT NOT NULL,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'running',
                'completed',
                'partial',
                'failed'
            )
        ),

    parameters JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    result JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_system_audit_events_recent
ON system_audit_events(
    created_at DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_system_audit_events_clinic
ON system_audit_events(
    clinic_id,
    event_category,
    created_at DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workflow_error_events_open
ON workflow_error_events(
    severity,
    last_occurred_at DESC
)
WHERE status IN (
    'open',
    'acknowledged'
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workflow_error_events_workflow
ON workflow_error_events(
    workflow_name,
    last_occurred_at DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_system_health_snapshots_recent
ON system_health_snapshots(
    clinic_id,
    checked_at DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_maintenance_runs_recent
ON maintenance_runs(
    run_type,
    started_at DESC
);

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار Audit، Error Tracking، Health Snapshot و Maintenance Run ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

ساختارهای ایجادشده:
- Audit Event
- Workflow Error Event
- Health Snapshot
- Maintenance Run

این جداول برای پایش فنی هستند و جایگزین داده‌های عملیاتی بیمار نمی‌شوند.
